thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered for service=auth-svc, symptom=token-signing-failures, threshold=err_rate>200m over 2m. PD: https://pagerduty.example/pd/INC-4721

pagerduty-bot: ALERT: INC-4721 assigned to alex (on-call). Escalation in 10m if not acknowledged. Details: 502 from signing-api, KID mismatch observed in 95% of errors.

alex: acked. I'm on it. pulling logs and grabbing recent key rollover commits.

taylor: I saw traffic spike on signing-api ~2054320900. Could be key propagation issue from key-rotation job. tagging @security-bot.

sam: looping in infra — is there any recent deploy to auth-svc? I see a deploy ~2054319800 for feature/rotate-keys.

olivia: confirmed deploy and a KMS rotation job ran 3m before this alert. investigating whether JWKS published successfully.

alex: quick findings: signing API returns error: `kid not found` when validating incoming token header before signing. Logs from signing instance-22: 
```
ERROR auth.signing: unable to find key id="kid_2025_rot" for tenant=default
trace: lookup jwks cache miss -> fetch jwks -> 404
```
Looks like clients are sending tokens referencing new kid but our JWKS endpoint returned older set. possible race in propagation.

security-bot: Noted potential root cause: incomplete JWKS publish to CDN / edge. Suggest fallback to previous key set while we remediate.

pagerduty-bot: alex acknowledged INC-4721 at 2054321023. Time to acknowledge: 23s.

taylor: trying to replicate locally. if CDN didn't refresh, we can force a publish and clear cache. Running `infra/cdn/refresh --service auth-jwks --force`.

alex: running refresh now. `infra/cdn/refresh auth-jwks --edge all` -> started.

deploy-bot: publish-jwks job started by alex (runbook ref: /runbooks/auth/jwks-publish). Job id: publish-2054321030

sam: while publish runs, enabling fallback in signing service to accept previous KID for 60s window. small change, hot config toggle. Applying now.

alex: toggled `auth.signing.accept_previous_kid = true` on signing instances (canary). Pushing to 3/6 instances first.

olivia: edge refresh returned 200 for all regions. Polling JWKS endpoints... US: new KID present, EU: new KID present.

alex: monitoring error-rate graphs: errors dropped from 320/min -> 18/min over 4m since toggle + publish. Good.

pm_june: customers: currently seeing ~18 customer-facing errors at peak; we have 7 customer-reported logs from support (small set). Prepare short incident banner for status page? P1?

alex: marking P1 since token validation affects auth flows. I'll open incident ticket and write initial impact.

sam: quick note: we saw a cache TTL mismatch on the CDN side: publish job set asset but edge TTL=300s for some POPs, causing partial propagation. we've patched edge config to 60s for jwks assets.

olivia: additional mitigation: rolled back key-rotation job to previous state to prevent new keys from being issued until we have consistent publishing.

security-bot: recommended rotation audit: gather rotation job logs, KMS audit entries, and check signing service caches.

alex: collecting artifacts: logs, publish job stdout, CDN refresh outputs. attaching to INC-4721.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation window passed without further paging. No secondary escalation triggered.

pm_june: sent brief to customers via status page: "We experienced an authentication disruption caused by a key propagation issue. Most affected calls recovered after our mitigations; ongoing monitoring in place. Follow-up will include timeline and root cause."

olivia: post-mitigation metrics: token issuance success rate back to 99.94%. Throttled errors stabilized.

alex: can we cut a short postmortem? I'll own the incident but handing over to night oncall at 2054324400.

sam: added action items: (1) make jwks publish atomic and invalidate CDN edge immediately, (2) add monitoring for jwks divergence across regions, (3) review key rotation timing vs deploy.

olivia: I'll own monitoring item. will add dashboard and 5m alert if region divergence >1 KID.

pm_june: prepping incident comms and follow-up. assigning postmortem to alex + olivia + security.

alex: handoff: @taylor you're night oncall now. I'll leave notes in the incident ticket. If anything spikes above 100/min reopen PD.

taylor: got it, taking over. thanks all. logging handoff at 2054324395.

security-bot: flagged for compliance: potential customer impact on token validations — keep retention of logs for 90 days.

incident-bot: Incident INC-4721 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Closed PD alert at 2054324520.

alex: will draft postmortem and ping for reviews in #postmortems tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:

pm_june: note for postmortem: quantify customer impact + timeline + rollback decision rationale.
